title: pellionia minutiflora
intro: Pellionia minutiflora, commonly known as the "Small-flowered Pellionia" or "Small-flowered Urostachys", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Urticaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellionia minutiflora include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
